provenance.method: Reviewer inspected the containing module and expression texts, all surface and derivative context texts, related-identity definitions, historical holds and current gates. The static assembler verifies pins and writes the recorded judgments; it is not an automated semantic review or production validator.

term_boundaries.broken: Accept only physical damage/nonfunctioning adjective language in the exact lexical projection. Broken seals, glass, links, repairs, reporting and external expression scoring remain separately pending.
term_boundaries.urgent: No medical assessment, emergency classification, response deadline or duty is accepted; caregiving urgency remains specialist context.
term_boundaries.unclear: No acceptance transfers to unclear use-by dates, inherited office-admin holds, uncertain commercial relationships, or clear/clarify family derivatives.
term_boundaries.safe: Safe-container nouns are separate from the physical-danger adjective. Safety/safely/safeguard derivatives and route or workplace safety judgments stay pending.
term_boundaries.unsafe: Entire lexical entry is held; no expression receives language or domain acceptance. Unsafe storage language does not approve a risk threshold.
term_boundaries.hazard: Entire lexical entry is held. Trip, slip, choking, electrical and pictogram contexts remain specialist/compound uses without approval.
term_boundaries.incident: Only the ordinary workplace-event lexical projection is accepted. Reporting forms, clinical incidents, IT response and incident-response compounds stay pending.
term_boundaries.concern: The countable worrying-matter noun is bounded. Plural concerns can be a noun or the verb is about; verb, priority, company and protective-interest contexts are not accepted.
term_boundaries.solution: Problem-response noun acceptance does not cover cleaning/chemical mixtures, problem-solving derivatives or new external scored bindings.
term_boundaries.procedure: Only the general established-method lexical projection is accepted. Isolation, lockout, housekeeping, medical and other specialist procedures are not approved.

matching_policy.scope: Expression text, case-insensitive word boundaries. Surface hits are not sense acceptance. Derivatives and compounds are a separate exclusion screen.
